translations.label: DewfordTown_House1_Text_Zigzagoon
translations.original: ZIGZAGOON: Guguuh!
translations.zh: 蛇纹熊：咕咕！

translations.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCut
translations.original:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.

An HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.

Any POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER
has earned the STONE BADGE.

And, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.
translations.zh:
这台秘传学习器记载的是居合斩。
秘传招式能在战斗之外使用。获得岩石徽章后，学会居合斩的宝可梦就能砍掉细树。
与招式学习器不同，秘传学习器可以反复使用。

translations.label: RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPutThisHMToGoodUse
translations.original:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…
And your well-trained POKéMON…

You're obviously a skilled TRAINER!

No, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.

I'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.

No need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!
translations.zh:
坚定的神情，灵活的动作，还有训练有素的宝可梦……
你显然是个出色的训练家！先别说话，我一眼就看出来了。
我相信你能好好利用这台秘传学习器。别客气，收下吧！

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldWeGetRobbed
translations.original:
It's beyond stupid.
How could we get robbed?
translations.zh: 真是太蠢了！我们怎么会被抢劫呢？

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAuthorizedPeopleEnter
translations.original:
I'm sorry, only authorized people
are allowed to enter here.
translations.zh: 抱歉，只有经过许可的人才能进入这里。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWasntVeryBright
translations.original:
That stolen parcel…

Well, sure it's important, but it's not
anything that anyone can use.

In my estimation, that robber must not
have been very bright.
translations.zh:
那个被偷的包裹……虽然很重要，但不是谁都能用的东西。
依我看，那个强盗一定不太聪明。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLikeStolenGoodsRecovered
translations.original:
It sounds like they've recovered
the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.
translations.zh: 听说被抢走的得文物品已经找回来了。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotRobbed
translations.original:
One of our research staff stupidly
got robbed of an important parcel.
translations.zh: 我们的一位研究员傻乎乎地被抢走了一个重要包裹。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoesAreOurProduct
translations.original:
Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!
They're one of our products!

It makes me happy when I see someone
using something we made.
translations.zh:
嘿，那双跑步鞋！那是我们的产品！
看到有人使用我们制造的东西，我就很高兴。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeToDevonCorp
translations.original:
Hello and welcome to the DEVON
CORPORATION.

We're proud producers of items and
medicine that enhance your life.
translations.zh:
你好，欢迎来到得文公司。
我们为能生产改善生活的道具和药品而自豪。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwaysWelcomeHere
translations.original:
Hi, there!
You're always welcome here!
translations.zh: 你好！这里随时欢迎你！

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNewPokenavFeature
translations.original:
I'm trying to develop a new feature
for the POKéNAV…

But it's not going well.
translations.zh:
我正在尝试开发宝可领航员的新功能……
但进展不太顺利。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopingNewBalls
translations.original:
I'm developing new kinds of
POKé BALLS…

But I haven't made much headway…
translations.zh:
我正在开发新型精灵球……
但还没有什么进展……

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceForTalkingToPokemon
translations.original:
We're developing a device for talking
with POKéMON.

But we haven't had much success…
translations.zh:
我们正在开发能和宝可梦说话的装置。
不过，还没有取得什么成果……

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToVisualizePokemonDreams
translations.original:
I'm trying to develop a device that
visually reproduces the dreams of
POKéMON…

But it's not going well.
translations.zh:
我正在尝试开发能把宝可梦的梦显示出来的装置……
但进展不太顺利。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePokenav
translations.original:
I made the POKéNAV!

As an engineer, I feel blessed to have
made something so great!
translations.zh:
宝可领航员是我开发的！
作为工程师，能造出这么棒的东西，我感到非常幸运！

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinallyMadeNewBalls
translations.original:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!

The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.

The TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.

Both are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.

Please give them a try!
translations.zh:
我们终于造出了新型精灵球！
重复球能更容易捕捉以前捉到过的宝可梦。
战斗持续得越久，计时球就越容易捕捉宝可梦。
两种球都是得文公司的得意之作，请试试看！

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWorkOnNext
translations.original:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?

Our company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.

One couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.
translations.zh:
接下来开发什么好呢？
公司允许我们把灵感变成现实。对工程师来说，这是再好不过的环境了。

translations.label: RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsAPokenav
translations.original:
Oh, wow!
That's a POKéNAV!

It came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about
the feelings of POKéMON.

Would you like me to describe its
features in detail?

No, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.
translations.zh:
哦，哇！那是宝可领航员！
它源于社长想了解宝可梦心情的愿望。
要我详细介绍功能吗？不，不用。你自己用一用就会明白了。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_Skitty
translations.original: SKITTY: Gyaaaah!
translations.zh: 向尾喵：喵啊！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAtDevonToo
translations.original:
My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

When I grow up, I'm going to work for
DEVON, too.
translations.zh:
我爸爸在得文公司工作。
等我长大了，也要去得文公司工作！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeThisYouCanHaveIt
translations.original:
My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

My daddy made this!
But I can't use it, so you can have it.
translations.zh:
我爸爸在得文公司工作。
这个是爸爸做的！我用不上，就送给你吧。

translations.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPekachu
translations.original:
But giving the name PEKACHU to
a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.

I suppose it is good to use a name
that's easy to understand, but…
translations.zh:
给皮卡丘取名叫“皮卡啾”？好像没什么意义。
虽说容易理解的名字也不错，不过……

translations.label: RustboroCity_House3_Text_Pekachu
translations.original: PEKACHU: Peka!
translations.zh: 皮卡啾：皮卡！

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQuickClaw
translations.original:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move
before its opponent.

There are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.

Just those alone will give you many
topics to study!
translations.zh:
携带先制之爪的宝可梦，有时能加快动作，比对手先出招。
还有许多供宝可梦携带的道具，光这些就足够研究很久了！

translations.label: RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentsWhoDontStudyGetQuickClaw
translations.original:
Students who don't study get a little
taste of my QUICK CLAW.

Whether or not you are a good student 
will be evident from the way you use
this item.
translations.zh:
不好好学习的学生，可要尝尝我的先制之爪！
你会如何使用这件道具，就能看出你是不是个好学生。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym
translations.original:
Have you taken the POKéMON GYM
challenge?

When you get that shiny GYM BADGE
in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to
realize what is required of them.
translations.zh:
你挑战过宝可梦道馆吗？
当闪亮的道馆徽章握在手中时，训练家才开始明白自己肩上的责任吧。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBadge
translations.original:
Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!

Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,
RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.
translations.zh:
咦，那是卡那兹道馆的徽章！
要我说，所有道馆徽章里，卡那兹的徽章最酷！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko
translations.original:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.

That old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.
translations.zh:
老水手哈奇爷爷住在海边的小屋里。
他说要去凯那市给他的皮皮买东西。那位老船长一定很疼爱皮皮！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunnel
translations.original:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He goes for walks in the tunnel every
so often.
translations.zh:
老水手哈奇爷爷住在海边的小屋里。
他时不时会去隧道散步。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFromExp
translations.original:
If a POKéMON gains experience in
battles, it can sometimes change in
the way it looks.
translations.zh: 宝可梦在战斗中获得经验，有时外貌也会改变。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape
translations.original:
A POKéMON changes shape?
If one did that, I would be shocked!
translations.zh: 宝可梦会改变模样？要是发生这种事，我一定会大吃一惊！

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAroundCorner
translations.original:
Hm? A sneaky-looking man?

Come to think of it, yes, a shady-
looking guy went around the corner.
translations.zh:
嗯？一个鬼鬼祟祟的人？
这么说来，确实有个可疑的家伙拐过了街角。

translations.label: RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon
translations.original:
The DEVON CORPORATION…
We all just shorten it to DEVON.

That company makes all sorts of
convenient products.
translations.zh:
得文制造股份有限公司……我们都简称它为得文公司。
那家公司制造各种方便的产品。

translations.label: gText_TooBadBagIsFull
translations.original:
Too bad!
The BAG is full…
translations.zh: 你的背包装满了，无法接收这个道具。

facts.summary: FLAG_MET_DEVON_EMPLOYEE对应116道路会面，与森林救援/归还包裹独立。
居合斩HM可重复使用；野外砍树另外要求岩石徽章。满包采用网页实际到账后才标领取的恢复政策。

scenarios.summary: 从左右入口执行来源全部逐格路径与等待，回到5,3后发先制之爪；另测满包、重入与保存。步态/原机逐帧观感未验收。
普通赠礼、收到后说明以及容量失败重试；原子到账/旗标/奖励账本分离。
